items.original_text: Estimated time: 240 to 540 days. Estimated government cost: $7,500 to $24,000. Notes: The timeline is 240–540 days to approval of the Conditional Use Authorization, Place of Entertainment permit, ABC Type 42 license, Health permit and Building permit, measured from first filing to the last approval. The CUA alone takes 120–300 days from filing to Commission approval (catalog:sf.conditional_use_authorization); the POE permit takes 45–120 days after the CUA is approved (catalog:sf.place_of_entertainment_permit); the ABC Type 42 application takes 60–150 days if unprotested, longer if a Public Convenience or Necessity finding is required due to census tract undue concentration (catalog:ca.abc_type_42); the Health plan check takes 21–60 days and the permit to operate another 14–45 days after final inspection (catalog:sf.health_plan_check, catalog:sf.health_permit); the Building permit takes 14–120 days for plan review and issuance (catalog:sf.building_permit). These approvals run partly in parallel (ABC and building permits can be filed after the CUA is approved, and the health permit after DPH plan check), so the total elapsed time to open is roughly 8–18 months if all approvals are granted. Cost includes CUA filing fee $3,100–$15,000 depending on construction cost (catalog:sf.conditional_use_authorization), POE permit $2,708–$3,800 (catalog:sf.place_of_entertainment_permit), ABC Type 42 application $1,000–$1,600 (catalog:ca.abc_type_42), DPH plan check $828–$2,500 and permit to operate $470–$1,000 (catalog:sf.health_plan_check, catalog:sf.health_permit), building permit $800–$15,000 depending on construction valuation (catalog:sf.building_permit), business registration $55–$700 (catalog:sf.business_registration), sign permit $300–$1,500 (catalog:sf.sign_permit), and state fees (entity registration $70–$150, seller's permit $0, EDD registration $0, food safety manager cert $100–$250, RBS training $3–$30 per employee). The cost range does not include the price of purchasing and transferring an ABC Type 42 license from another bar within the Mission Alcohol SUD if Planning confirms that is required; license transfer prices are not government fees and are not included in the catalog. It also does not include architecture, construction, a license broker, or legal fees. The timeline and cost are for approvals when they are granted; if the CUA or ABC license is denied or the applicant withdraws, the time and cost to that point are lost.

outcomes.original: Estimated time: 240 to 540 days. Estimated government cost: $7,500 to $24,000. Notes: The timeline is 240–540 days to approval of the Conditional Use Authorization, Place of Entertainment permit, ABC Type 42 license, Health permit and Building permit, measured from first filing to the last approval. The CUA alone takes 120–300 days from filing to Commission approval (catalog:sf.conditional_use_authorization); the POE permit takes 45–120 days after the CUA is approved (catalog:sf.place_of_entertainment_permit); the ABC Type 42 application takes 60–150 days if unprotested, longer if a Public Convenience or Necessity finding is required due to census tract undue concentration (catalog:ca.abc_type_42); the Health plan check takes 21–60 days and the permit to operate another 14–45 days after final inspection (catalog:sf.health_plan_check, catalog:sf.health_permit); the Building permit takes 14–120 days for plan review and issuance (catalog:sf.building_permit). These approvals run partly in parallel (ABC and building permits can be filed after the CUA is approved, and the health permit after DPH plan check), so the total elapsed time to open is roughly 8–18 months if all approvals are granted. Cost includes CUA filing fee $3,100–$15,000 depending on construction cost (catalog:sf.conditional_use_authorization), POE permit $2,708–$3,800 (catalog:sf.place_of_entertainment_permit), ABC Type 42 application $1,000–$1,600 (catalog:ca.abc_type_42), DPH plan check $828–$2,500 and permit to operate $470–$1,000 (catalog:sf.health_plan_check, catalog:sf.health_permit), building permit $800–$15,000 depending on construction valuation (catalog:sf.building_permit), business registration $55–$700 (catalog:sf.business_registration), sign permit $300–$1,500 (catalog:sf.sign_permit), and state fees (entity registration $70–$150, seller's permit $0, EDD registration $0, food safety manager cert $100–$250, RBS training $3–$30 per employee). The cost range does not include the price of purchasing and transferring an ABC Type 42 license from another bar within the Mission Alcohol SUD if Planning confirms that is required; license transfer prices are not government fees and are not included in the catalog. It also does not include architecture, construction, a license broker, or legal fees. The timeline and cost are for approvals when they are granted; if the CUA or ABC license is denied or the applicant withdraws, the time and cost to that point are lost.
